// Zero Power: Apex Arrow — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

// Re-run tools/safe-edit/bin/_build-dungeon-animations.js to regenerate.

(async () => {

const CFG = {"move":"apex","casterFoot":0.95,"partyFoot":0.97,"seed":2525,"volume":0.75,"totalTimeoutMs":22000,"flip":560,"slow":750,"height":150,"zoom":1.25,"live":false};

const ASSETS = {"clips":{"wind":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/RPG%20Maker%20MV/091_wind_one_1.webm","w":508,"h":510,"dur":1000,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.8529,"k":0.55,"add":false}},"sfx":{"overdrive":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Overdrive.wav","evade":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Evasion1.ogg","bow1":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Crossbow.ogg","hitpierceb":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Hit_PiercingB.ogg","jump2":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_BTL_HighJump.ogg","sword1":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Sword1.ogg","charging":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/ChargingA.wav","shukuchi":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Shukuchi.wav","crit":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_BTL_HitCritical.ogg","magic4":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Magic4.ogg"},"images":{"cut":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Campaign/The%20Legend%20of%20Dragonslayer/Image/NPCs/Jack/Jack_Standard.png"}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.legacy-jack-apex-arrow";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Zero Power: Apex Arrow]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Zero Power kit (prepended after the party _kit by zp-signatures.js) ──────

// Shared pieces of the four party Zero Powers (2026-11-06 overhaul, mockup v17):

// the shipped full-body cut-in, hit cues, the cast focus fade, the game's flinch

// for painted copies, screen anchors for numbers, and small particle helpers.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const ZP = {};

// Fire something ONCE when the timeline reaches 'at' (tracks run per frame while

// t0 <= t < t1, so a 1 ms window can be skipped; this one stays open).

ZP.once = (m, at, fn) => { let done = false; m.hold(at, 1e9, () => { if (done) return; done = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[ZP] once threw', e); } }); };

// A Chain tick: reveals the next strike (number, HP bar, counter) on the acting GM.

// info: { numbersOnly, screenAt: { [tokenUuid]: { fx, fy } } } or a function returning it.

// paced: every Zero Power cues each strike itself, so the presenter never fills a gap with its own beat.

ZP.hit = (m, at, info) => ZP.once(m, at, () => oni.hit(Object.assign({ paced: true }, typeof info === 'function' ? info() : (info || {}))));

// The shipped Zero Power cut-in (createCutinDOM/runCutinDOM): a full-body image

// 92% of the view tall on the bottom edge; left -120% -> 0 (CSS ease-out, 650 ms),

// hold 850 ms, -> 120% (CSS ease-in, 650 ms). Drawn in screen space above the board.

// Needs A.images[key]; Overdrive is a cfg sfx cue at the same time.

ZP.cssOut = (t) => ZP.bez(0, 0, 0.58, 1, t);

ZP.cssIn = (t) => ZP.bez(0.42, 0, 1, 1, t);

ZP.bez = (x1, y1, x2, y2, x) => { let t = x; for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const cx = 3 * x1, bx = 3 * (x2 - x1) - cx, ax = 1 - cx - bx; const fx = ((ax * t + bx) * t + cx) * t - x; const d = (3 * ax * t + 2 * bx) * t + cx; if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-6) break; t -= fx / d; } const cy = 3 * y1, by = 3 * (y2 - y1) - cy, ay = 1 - cy - by; return ((ay * t + by) * t + cy) * t; };

ZP.cutin = (tl, m, at, key, o) => {

o = o || {}; const inMs = o.slideIn || 650, hold = o.hold || 850, outMs = o.slideOut || 650; const end = inMs + hold + outMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => { const img = tl.IMG[key]; if (!img) return; (o.over ? S.over : S.screen).push({ draw: (g) => {

const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = g.H * 0.92, w = h * iw / ih;

const x = e < inMs ? -1.2 * g.W * (1 - ZP.cssOut(e / inMs)) : e < inMs + hold ? 0 : 1.2 * g.W * ZP.cssIn((e - inMs - hold) / outMs);

g.save(); g.globalAlpha = 1; g.drawImage(img, x, g.H - h, w, h); g.restore(); } }); });

return at + end;

};

// Everyone on the board who is not the caster or a target, as extra timeline tokens

// ('b0', 'b1', ...), so the cast focus can fade them. Summon tokens already on the

// field are bystanders too (the user's dedupe rule: the parade never shows a real

// Crysta next to the drawn one). keep: extra tokens to leave alone.

ZP.bystanders = (keep) => {

const out = {}; const skip = new Set(); if (caster) skip.add(caster.id); for (const t of targets) skip.add(t.id); for (const t of (keep || [])) if (t) skip.add(t.id);

let n = 0; for (const t of (canvas.tokens && canvas.tokens.placeables) || []) { if (skip.has(t.id) || !t.visible || !t.mesh || (t.document && t.document.hidden)) continue; out['b' + (n++)] = { token: t }; }

return out;

};

// Fade the bystanders out from 'at' over ms, keep them out until 'back', fade back over backMs.

ZP.focus = (m, TOK, at, ms, back, backMs) => {

const keys = Object.keys(TOK).filter((k) => k.charAt(0) === 'b' && /^b[0-9]+$/.test(k));

for (const k of keys) m.hold(at, back + backMs, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; const t = e + at; let a; if (t < at + ms) a = 1 - (t - at) / ms; else if (t < back) a = 0; else a = Math.min(1, (t - back) / backMs); if (a < 1) { if (a <= 0.001) q.hidden = true; else q.alpha *= a; } });

return keys;

};

// The game's FULL_FLINCH (battler-pose.js): [time, scaleX, scaleY, shiftX px] and brightness.

ZP.FLINCH = {

normal: { ms: 300, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.12, 1.12, 0.88, 0], [0.30, 0.97, 1.03, -7], [0.50, 1, 1, 6], [0.70, 1, 1, -4], [0.85, 1, 1, 3], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 3.6], [0.35, 1], [1, 1]] },

strong: { ms: 480, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.10, 1.22, 0.80, 0], [0.26, 0.90, 1.10, -13], [0.44, 1, 1, 11], [0.62, 1, 1, -7], [0.80, 1, 1, 5], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 4], [0.20, 1], [0.40, 3.2], [0.60, 1], [1, 1]] },

};

ZP.stop = (stops, t, col) => { for (let i = 1; i < stops.length; i++) if (t <= stops[i][0]) { const a = stops[i - 1], b = stops[i]; const u = (t - a[0]) / Math.max(1e-6, b[0] - a[0]); const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u); return a[col] + (b[col] - a[col]) * k; } return stops[stops.length - 1][col]; };

// Flinch sample at ms since the hit: { sx, sy, dx, b (brightness) } or null when over.

ZP.flinchAt = (ms, tier) => { const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier || 'normal']; if (ms < 0 || ms >= F.ms) return null; const u = ms / F.ms; return { sx: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 1), sy: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 2), dx: ZP.stop(F.move, u, 3), b: ZP.stop(F.bright, u, 1) }; };

// The hurt reaction on a PAINTED timeline token k at 'at': its hurt art (sprite_hurt,

// the engine's hurt loop) for hurtMs with the flinch on top, else the flinch alone.

// Use with oni.hit({ numbersOnly: true }) so the game's own DOM flinch stays off.

ZP.flinchTok = (m, at, k, tier, hurtMs) => {

const F = ZP.FLINCH[tier || 'normal']; const hold = Math.max(F.ms, hurtMs == null ? 700 : hurtMs);

m.hold(at, at + hold, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; q.hurt = true; const f = ZP.flinchAt(e, tier); if (!f) return; q.sx *= f.sx; q.sy *= f.sy; q.dx += f.dx; if (f.b > 1.05) { const a = Math.min(1, (f.b - 1) / 3); if (a > q.tintA) { q.tint = '#ffffff'; q.tintA = a; } } });

};

// Screen anchor for a damage number at screen px (x, y) of the overlay: board-view fractions.

ZP.frac = (g, x, y) => ({ fx: x / g.W, fy: y / g.H });

// Splitting for a drawn pseudo multi-hit preview (bench only; in battle the numbers come from BD).

ZP.split = (total, n) => { const out = []; let prev = 0; for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) { const c = Math.round(total * i / n); out.push(c - prev); prev = c; } return out; };

// A soft additive glow (canvas 2D).

ZP.glow = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0) || !(a > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); };

// A deterministic particle field for a track: n particles from seed, each p(i, r) => spec,

// drawn by draw(g, p, e). Lets a whole ember/dust swarm live in one track (no per-frame spawns).

ZP.swarm = (tl, n, seed, make) => { const r = tl.rng(seed || 3); const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) out.push(make(i, r)); return out; };

// A glow-sprite with a black backing turned into real alpha (alpha = brightness), cached.

ZP._ga = new Map();

ZP.glowAlpha = (img) => { if (!img) return null; if (ZP._ga.has(img)) return ZP._ga.get(img); const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width, h = img.naturalHeight || img.height; if (!w || !h) return null; const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0);

try { const id = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h), d = id.data; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) { const mx = Math.max(d[i], d[i + 1], d[i + 2]); if (mx > 0) { d[i] = d[i] * 255 / mx; d[i + 1] = d[i + 1] * 255 / mx; d[i + 2] = d[i + 2] * 255 / mx; } d[i + 3] = mx; } x.putImageData(id, 0, 0); } catch (e) { return img; }

ZP._ga.set(img, cv); return cv; };

// Tip and joint of a Disgaea weapon part, read from its alpha (top-most / bottom-most opaque rows).

ZP._li = new Map();

ZP.limbInfo = (img) => { if (ZP._li.has(img)) return ZP._li.get(img); const w = img.naturalWidth || img.width, h = img.naturalHeight || img.height; const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = w; cv.height = h; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0); let d; try { d = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data; } catch (e) { const r0 = { tip: { x: w / 2, y: 0 }, joint: { x: w / 2, y: h } }; ZP._li.set(img, r0); return r0; }

const row = (y) => { let a = -1, b = -1; for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) if (d[(y * w + i) * 4 + 3] > 90) { if (a < 0) a = i; b = i; } return a < 0 ? null : (a + b) / 2; };

let tip = null, joint = null; for (let y = 0; y < h && !tip; y++) { const c = row(y); if (c != null) tip = { x: c, y }; } for (let y = h - 1; y >= 0 && !joint; y--) { const c = row(y); if (c != null) joint = { x: c, y }; }

const r = { tip: tip || { x: w / 2, y: 0 }, joint: joint || { x: w / 2, y: h } }; ZP._li.set(img, r); return r; };

// ── Legacy twins kit (Jack + Jill, + the shared Mug / Cleaving Strike Rauben also uses) ──────────────

// Prepended (after the Zero Power kit) by legacy-twins-signatures.js. A canvas-2D port of the mockup's

// shared kit ("Legacy boss animations" mockup, part-common.js + the round-3 afterimage / comic puff):

// a keyframed body for the caster, afterimage ghosts, a stepped particle field (ground / field / hit

// layers), projectiles with glow trails, rings, cracks, dust, twinkles, wisps, coins, the impact frame,

// radial speed lines and the pixel-crisp Zero Power cut-in.

// LIVE board: the camera is never touched; only bodies a beat moves are painted. Every mockup number is

// in mockup px on a 1682 px stage and is scaled by KP (stage width / 1682) and the depth ratio.

// Mirroring: the mockup's enemy faces right; every x offset and rotation is multiplied by DIR.

// No backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && t !== caster);

if (!caster) { oni.fireDone(); return; }

const tokens = { k: { token: caster, foot: cfg.casterFoot } };

const FOES = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; FOES.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t, foot: cfg.partyFoot }; });

const CL = A.clips || {};

// cfg.live false = FULL TAKEOVER (the shot owns the board and drives S.cam: Apex Arrow's push-in); else LIVE board

const LIVE = cfg.live !== false;

const tl = oni.timeline(LIVE ? { tokens, clips: CL, images: A.images || {}, live: true, depthRef: 'k' } : { tokens, clips: CL, images: A.images || {} });

await tl.load();

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp, TOK = tl.TOK, feet = tl.feet;

const KP = (tl.STAGE.w || 1682) / 1682;

const R = tl.rng(cfg.seed || 2525);

const rnd = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

const T = [], sfx = [];

const m = tl.mk(T);

const once = (at, fn) => { let did = false; T.push({ t0: at, t1: 1e9, fn: () => { if (!did) { did = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[ONI][twins] cue threw', e); } } } }); };

const S_ = (at, url, v) => { if (url) sfx.push({ at: Math.round(at), url, v: v * (cfg.volume == null ? 0.75 : cfg.volume) }); };

const SX = (at, key, v) => S_(at, (A.sfx || {})[key], v);

const DEG = Math.PI / 180;

const K = TOK.k, KF = feet(K);

// facing: toward the first target; with none (a self-cast) the way the caster's art faces

const DIR = FOES.length ? (TOK[FOES[0]].x >= K.x ? 1 : -1) : (K.dir || 1);

const DR = (pt) => tl.depthRatio(KF, pt); // size at pt vs the caster's spot

const HB = (k) => TOK[k].h * TOK[k].foot; // body height above the feet

const tFeet = (k) => feet(TOK[k]);

const tCenter = (k) => { const f = feet(TOK[k]); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - HB(k) * 0.5 }; };

// a spot in front of a target, on the caster's side (the mockup's front(t, gap))

const front = (k, gap) => { const f = tFeet(k); return { x: f.x - DIR * gap * KP * DR(f), y: f.y }; };

// EASE names as the mockup has them

const EZ = { lin: E.lin, quad: E.ioQ, out: E.outQ, in: E.inQ, outCubic: E.outC, sine: E.sine };

const EOUTBACK = (u) => { const c1 = 1.70158, c3 = c1 + 1; return 1 + c3 * Math.pow(u - 1, 3) + c1 * Math.pow(u - 1, 2); };

// ── the caster's body: keyframed channels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

// dx / dy (scene px), lift (scene px), rot (deg, the mockup's enemy sign), sx / sy, hop (an arc on top

// of the lift), pivot (0 = feet, 1 = the mockup's 50% 55% spin pivot).

const chan = (v0) => ({ v0, segs: [] });

const valAt = (c, t) => { let v = c.v0; for (const s of c.segs) { if (t < s.t0) break; const u = s.t1 > s.t0 ? Math.min(1, (t - s.t0) / (s.t1 - s.t0)) : 1; v = s.fn ? (t >= s.t1 ? s.fn(1) : s.fn(u)) : (t >= s.t1 ? s.to : lerp(s.from, s.to, s.ease(u))); } return v; };

const key = (c, at, ms, to, ease) => { const from = valAt(c, at); c.segs.push({ t0: at, t1: at + Math.max(0, ms), from, to, ease: ease || E.lin }); c.segs.sort((a, b) => a.t0 - b.t0); };

const keyFn = (c, at, ms, fn) => { c.segs.push({ t0: at, t1: at + Math.max(1, ms), fn }); c.segs.sort((a, b) => a.t0 - b.t0); };

const BODY = { dx: chan(0), dy: chan(0), lift: chan(0), hop: chan(0), rot: chan(0), sx: chan(1), sy: chan(1), pivot: chan(0) };

let BODY_END = 0;

// pose at t: what the engine draws, plus the un-pivoted lift (anchor points use that, as the mockup does)

function pose(t) {

const dx = valAt(BODY.dx, t), dy = valAt(BODY.dy, t), lift = valAt(BODY.lift, t) + valAt(BODY.hop, t);

const rot = valAt(BODY.rot, t) * DIR * DEG, sx = valAt(BODY.sx, t), sy = valAt(BODY.sy, t);

let air = lift, ddx = dx;

if (valAt(BODY.pivot, t) >= 0.5 && rot) { const r = (dx || dy) ? tl.depthRatio(KF, { x: KF.x + dx, y: KF.y + dy }) : 1; const ph = K.h * (K.foot - 0.55) * r * sy; ddx -= ph * Math.sin(rot); air += ph * (1 - Math.cos(rot)); }

return { dx: ddx, dy, air, rot, sx, sy, lift, bx: dx };

}

// moves (mockup: moveActor / goHome / lean / squash / liftTo / spin)

const moveTo = (at, ms, pt, ease, o) => { o = o || {}; key(BODY.dx, at, ms, pt.x - KF.x, ease || EZ.sine); key(BODY.dy, at, ms, pt.y - KF.y, ease || EZ.sine); if (o.hop) { const h = o.hop * KP; keyFn(BODY.hop, at, ms, (u) => Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * h); } if (o.trail) for (const f of [0.31, 0.62, 0.93]) ghostAt(at + ms * f, o.ghost || {}); return at + ms; };

const goHome = (at, ms, o) => moveTo(at, ms, KF, EZ.quad, o);

const lean = (at, ms, deg, ease) => { key(BODY.rot, at, ms, deg, ease || EZ.out); return at + ms; };

const squash = (at, ms, sx, sy, ease) => { key(BODY.sx, at, ms, sx, ease || EZ.out); key(BODY.sy, at, ms, sy, ease || EZ.out); return at + ms; };

const liftTo = (at, ms, h, ease) => { key(BODY.lift, at, ms, h * KP, ease || EZ.outCubic); return at + ms; };

const pivot = (at, mid) => key(BODY.pivot, at, 0, mid ? 1 : 0);

// anchor points on the caster (mockup hand(a) / bodyAt(a) / feet(a)), at time t

const casterPt = (t, u, v) => { const p = pose(t), r = (p.bx || p.dy) ? tl.depthRatio(KF, { x: KF.x + p.bx, y: KF.y + p.dy }) : 1; return { x: KF.x + p.bx + DIR * K.w * u * r, y: KF.y + p.dy - p.lift - HB('k') * v * r }; };

const hand = (t) => casterPt(t, 0.3, 0.62);

const bodyAt = (t) => casterPt(t, 0, 0.5);

const cFeet = (t) => casterPt(t, 0, 0);

const headAt = (t) => casterPt(t, 0, 0.95);

// ── art copies: afterimage ghosts, scaling copies, a glow ring behind the body ──────────────

const ART = tl.art('k');

const bake = (filter, pad) => { if (!ART) return null; const w = ART.naturalWidth || ART.videoWidth || ART.width, h = ART.naturalHeight || ART.videoHeight || ART.height; if (!w || !h) return null; pad = pad || 0;

const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w + pad * 2; c.height = h + pad * 2; const x = c.getContext('2d'); try { x.filter = filter || 'none'; x.drawImage(ART, pad, pad, w, h); } catch (e) { return null; } return { cv: c, pad, w, h }; };

const GHOST = {};

const ghostImg = (o) => { const f = o.filter || (o.hue == null ? 'brightness(1.6) saturate(.4)' : 'sepia(1) saturate(5) hue-rotate(' + (o.hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(1.35)'); if (!(f in GHOST)) GHOST[f] = bake(f, 0); return GHOST[f]; };

// draw a copy of the caster's art at pose p (es = extra scale about the feet)

function drawCopy(g, B, p, alpha, es) {

if (!B || alpha <= 0) return; es = es || 1;

const r = (p.dx || p.dy) ? tl.depthRatio(KF, { x: KF.x + p.dx, y: KF.y + p.dy }) : 1;

const padW = B.pad * K.w / B.w, padH = B.pad * K.h / B.h;

g.save(); g.translate(K.x + p.dx, KF.y + p.dy - p.air); if (p.rot) g.rotate(p.rot); g.scale(K.flip * p.sx * r * es, p.sy * r * es); g.globalAlpha = alpha;

g.drawImage(B.cv, -K.w / 2 - padW, -K.h * K.foot - padH, K.w + padW * 2, K.h + padH * 2); g.restore();

}

// one ghost spawned at 'at' showing the pose of that moment, fading over o.ms (mockup afterimage)

const GHOSTS = [];

function ghostAt(at, o) { o = o || {}; GHOSTS.push({ at, ms: o.ms || 380, op: o.opacity == null ? 0.5 : o.opacity, img: ghostImg(o) }); }

const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][Apex Arrow]";

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

p.meta = p.meta || {};

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

const firstTargetUuid = targetUuids[0] ?? null;

if (!firstTargetUuid) {

console.log(TAG, "No target found. Skipping Apex Arrow logic.");

return;

}

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(firstTargetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve first target actor.", { firstTargetUuid });

return;

/* ----------------------------------------- */

/* 1) EXECUTE */

/* Deals 200% damage to targets in Crisis */

/* ----------------------------------------- */

const CRISIS_EFFECT_ID = "5jkr80zqdzaR003d";

const crisisEffect =

targetActor.effects?.find(e => String(e?.id ?? e?._id ?? "") === CRISIS_EFFECT_ID) ??

targetActor.effects?.find(e => e?.name === "Crisis");

if (crisisEffect) {

const beforeMult = Number(p.advPayload.multiplier ?? 100) || 100;

const afterMult = beforeMult * 2;

p.advPayload.multiplier = afterMult;

multiplierBefore: beforeMult,

multiplierAfter: afterMult

});

} else {

context.log("Execute skipped - target is not in Crisis", {

target: targetActor?.name

});

}

/* ----------------------------------------- */

/* 2) DEADLY MARKSMANSHIP */

/* Apply after Execute is calculated */

/* ----------------------------------------- */

const DEADLY_TAG = "[CL-ACTION][DEADLY-MARKSMANSHIP]";

// Read final action accuracy total AFTER other accuracy bonuses

const accTotal = Number(p?.accuracy?.total ?? NaN);

// Read target defense from defense snapshot first, actor data as fallback

const getDef = (targetUuid, actor) => {

const row = p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget?.find(r => r?.uuid === targetUuid);

return Number(row?.defense ?? actor?.system?.props?.defense ?? 0) || 0;

};

? Math.max(0, accTotal - targetDef)

: 0;

accuracyTotal: accTotal,

targetDef,

deadlyBonus,

bonusBefore,

bonusAfter

bonusAfter

const TAG = "[CL-RES][Apex Arrow]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

const attackerUuid = p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerUuid ?? "";

if (!attackerUuid) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing attacker UUID.");

return;

}

const attackerDoc = await fromUuid(attackerUuid);

const casterActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

if (!casterActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve caster actor.", { attackerUuid });

return;

}

const EFFECT_NAME = "Apex Arrow";

const EFFECT_ICON = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Skill%20Icon/FFXIVIcons%20Battle(PvE)/11_BRD/apex_arrow.png";

// Remove older copy first so the buff refreshes cleanly

const existing = casterActor.effects.filter(e => e.name === EFFECT_NAME);

for (const eff of existing) {

await eff.delete();

}

const combat = game.combat ?? null;

const currentRound = Number(combat?.round ?? 0) || 0;

// It should remain for:

// - the rest of the current round

// - the whole next round

// and disappear at the END of next round,

// which means removal when the combat advances past currentRound + 1.

const expireAfterRound = currentRound + 1;

const effectData = {

name: EFFECT_NAME,

img: EFFECT_ICON,

description: "Gaining significant Accuracy increase",

disabled: false,

changes: [

{

key: "attack_accuracy_mod_all",

mode: CONST.ACTIVE_EFFECT_MODES.ADD,

value: "5",

priority: 1

}

],

duration: combat

? {

startRound: currentRound,

rounds: 2

}

: {},

flags: {

world: {

apexArrowBuff: true,

expireCombatId: combat?.id ?? null,

expireAfterRound

}

}

};

const [effect] = await casterActor.createEmbeddedDocuments("ActiveEffect", [effectData]);

console.log(TAG, "Apex Arrow buff created.", {

caster: casterActor?.name,

effectId: effect?.id,

combatId: combat?.id ?? null,

currentRound,

expireAfterRound

});

// Cleanup old hook for this actor/skill if one exists

globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore ??= {};

const hookKey = `${casterActor.id}:ApexArrow`;

const oldHookId = globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore[hookKey];

if (oldHookId != null) {

Hooks.off("updateCombat", oldHookId);

delete globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore[hookKey];

}

// Reliable expiration in combat

if (combat) {

const sourceCombatId = combat.id;

const sourceActorId = casterActor.id;

const sourceEffectId = effect.id;

const hookId = Hooks.on("updateCombat", async (updatedCombat, changed) => {

if (updatedCombat?.id !== sourceCombatId) return;

if (changed.round === undefined) return;

const liveActor = game.actors.get(sourceActorId);

if (!liveActor) {

Hooks.off("updateCombat", hookId);

if (globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore?.[hookKey] === hookId) {

delete globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore[hookKey];

}

return;

}

const liveEffect =

liveActor.effects.get(sourceEffectId) ??

liveActor.effects.find(e => e.name === EFFECT_NAME);

if (!liveEffect) {

Hooks.off("updateCombat", hookId);

if (globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore?.[hookKey] === hookId) {

delete globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore[hookKey];

}

return;

}

const newRound = Number(updatedCombat?.round ?? 0) || 0;

// Remove at the start of the round AFTER next round,

// which is effectively the end of next round.

if (newRound <= expireAfterRound) return;

Hooks.off("updateCombat", hookId);

if (globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore?.[hookKey] === hookId) {

delete globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore[hookKey];

}

await liveEffect.delete();

console.log(TAG, "Apex Arrow buff expired.", {

caster: liveActor?.name,

removedAtRound: newRound,

intendedExpireAfterRound: expireAfterRound

});

});

globalThis.__oniApexArrowHookStore[hookKey] = hookId;

} else {

console.warn(TAG, "No active combat found. Buff created, but timed expiry hook was not attached.");

}

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Zero Power kit (prepended after the party _kit by zp-signatures.js) ──────

// Shared pieces of the four party Zero Powers (2026-11-06 overhaul, mockup v17):

// the shipped full-body cut-in, hit cues, the cast focus fade, the game's flinch

// for painted copies, screen anchors for numbers, and small particle helpers.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const ZP = {};

// Fire something ONCE when the timeline reaches 'at' (tracks run per frame while

// t0 <= t < t1, so a 1 ms window can be skipped; this one stays open).

ZP.once = (m, at, fn) => { let done = false; m.hold(at, 1e9, () => { if (done) return; done = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[ZP] once threw', e); } }); };

ZP.cssOut = (t) => ZP.bez(0, 0, 0.58, 1, t);

ZP.cssIn = (t) => ZP.bez(0.42, 0, 1, 1, t);

ZP.bez = (x1, y1, x2, y2, x) => { let t = x; for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const cx = 3 * x1, bx = 3 * (x2 - x1) - cx, ax = 1 - cx - bx; const fx = ((ax * t + bx) * t + cx) * t - x; const d = (3 * ax * t + 2 * bx) * t + cx; if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-6) break; t -= fx / d; } const cy = 3 * y1, by = 3 * (y2 - y1) - cy, ay = 1 - cy - by; return ((ay * t + by) * t + cy) * t; };

ZP.cutin = (tl, m, at, key, o) => {

o = o || {}; const inMs = o.slideIn || 650, hold = o.hold || 850, outMs = o.slideOut || 650; const end = inMs + hold + outMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => { const img = tl.IMG[key]; if (!img) return; (o.over ? S.over : S.screen).push({ draw: (g) => {

const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = g.H * 0.92, w = h * iw / ih;

const x = e < inMs ? -1.2 * g.W * (1 - ZP.cssOut(e / inMs)) : e < inMs + hold ? 0 : 1.2 * g.W * ZP.cssIn((e - inMs - hold) / outMs);

g.save(); g.globalAlpha = 1; g.drawImage(img, x, g.H - h, w, h); g.restore(); } }); });

return at + end;

};

// Everyone on the board who is not the caster or a target, as extra timeline tokens

// ('b0', 'b1', ...), so the cast focus can fade them. Summon tokens already on the

// field are bystanders too (the user's dedupe rule: the parade never shows a real

// Crysta next to the drawn one). keep: extra tokens to leave alone.

ZP.bystanders = (keep) => {

const out = {}; const skip = new Set(); if (caster) skip.add(caster.id); for (const t of targets) skip.add(t.id); for (const t of (keep || [])) if (t) skip.add(t.id);

return out;

// Fade the bystanders out from 'at' over ms, keep them out until 'back', fade back over backMs.

ZP.focus = (m, TOK, at, ms, back, backMs) => {

const keys = Object.keys(TOK).filter((k) => k.charAt(0) === 'b' && /^b[0-9]+$/.test(k));

for (const k of keys) m.hold(at, back + backMs, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; const t = e + at; let a; if (t < at + ms) a = 1 - (t - at) / ms; else if (t < back) a = 0; else a = Math.min(1, (t - back) / backMs); if (a < 1) { if (a <= 0.001) q.hidden = true; else q.alpha *= a; } });

};

// The game's FULL_FLINCH (battler-pose.js): [time, scaleX, scaleY, shiftX px] and brightness.

ZP.FLINCH = {

normal: { ms: 300, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.12, 1.12, 0.88, 0], [0.30, 0.97, 1.03, -7], [0.50, 1, 1, 6], [0.70, 1, 1, -4], [0.85, 1, 1, 3], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 3.6], [0.35, 1], [1, 1]] },

strong: { ms: 480, move: [[0, 1, 1, 0], [0.10, 1.22, 0.80, 0], [0.26, 0.90, 1.10, -13], [0.44, 1, 1, 11], [0.62, 1, 1, -7], [0.80, 1, 1, 5], [1, 1, 1, 0]], bright: [[0, 4], [0.20, 1], [0.40, 3.2], [0.60, 1], [1, 1]] },

};

ZP.stop = (stops, t, col) => { for (let i = 1; i < stops.length; i++) if (t <= stops[i][0]) { const a = stops[i - 1], b = stops[i]; const u = (t - a[0]) / Math.max(1e-6, b[0] - a[0]); const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u); return a[col] + (b[col] - a[col]) * k; } return stops[stops.length - 1][col]; };

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

const userActor = await context.helpers.getAttackerActor();

if (!userActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing user actor.");

return;

}

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

if (!targetUuids.length) {

console.warn(TAG, "No targets found.");

return;

}

const accTotal = Number(p?.accuracy?.total ?? args?.accuracyTotal ?? NaN);

const hasAccuracy =

(typeof args?.hasAccuracy === "boolean") ? args.hasAccuracy : !!p?.accuracy;

const autoHit = !!(args?.autoHit || p?.advPayload?.autoHit || p?.accuracy?.isCrit);

const escapeHTML = foundry?.utils?.escapeHTML ?? ((v) => String(v ?? ""));

const getDef = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const row = p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget?.find(r => r?.uuid === targetUuid);

return Number(row?.defense ?? targetActor?.system?.props?.defense ?? 0) || 0;

};

const isHit = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const targetDef = getDef(targetUuid, targetActor);

if (!hasAccuracy) return true;

if (autoHit) return true;

if (!Number.isFinite(accTotal)) return false;

return accTotal >= targetDef;

};

const getUserTokenName = () => {

if (typeof _token !== "undefined" && _token?.name) return _token.name;

return userActor?.name ?? "User";

};

const getTargetDisplayName = (targetDoc, targetActor) => {

return targetDoc?.name ?? targetActor?.name ?? "Target";

};

async function postStealFeedbackHtml(innerHtml) {

const FLAG_SCOPE = "fabula-ultima-companion";

const FLAG_KEY = "oniHideChatHeader";

let hookId = null;

hookId = Hooks.on("renderChatMessage", (message, html) => {

if (!message?.getFlag?.(FLAG_SCOPE, FLAG_KEY)) return;

html.find(".message-header").remove();

html.find(".message-sender").remove();

html.find(".message-metadata").remove();

html.find(".message-avatar").remove();

html.find(".chat-portrait-container").remove();

html.find(".chat-portrait-message-portrait").remove();

html.find(".chat-portrait-image").remove();

html.find("img.chat-portrait").remove();

Hooks.off("renderChatMessage", hookId);

});

await ChatMessage.create({

user: game.user.id,

type: CONST.CHAT_MESSAGE_TYPES.OTHER,

speaker: { alias: "" },

content: `<div class="oni-steal-feedback">${innerHtml}</div>`,

flags: {

[FLAG_SCOPE]: {

[FLAG_KEY]: true

}

}

});

}

for (const targetUuid of targetUuids) {

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(targetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) continue;

const userTokenName = getUserTokenName();

const targetName = getTargetDisplayName(targetDoc, targetActor);

const targetDef = getDef(targetUuid, targetActor);

const hit = isHit(targetUuid, targetActor);

console.log(TAG, "HIT CHECK", {

user: userActor?.name,

userTokenName,

target: targetActor?.name,

targetName,

accTotal,

hasAccuracy,

autoHit,

targetDef,

hit

});

if (!hit) {

await postStealFeedbackHtml(`Fail to steal anything.`);

continue;

}

const targetIpBefore = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(targetActor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const userIpBefore = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(userActor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const userMaxIp = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(userActor?.system?.props?.max_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const requestedSteal = 2;

const actualSteal = Math.min(requestedSteal, targetIpBefore);

if (actualSteal <= 0) {

console.log(TAG, "No IP stolen", {

user: userActor?.name,

userTokenName,

target: targetActor?.name,

targetName,

requestedSteal,

targetIpBefore,

userIpBefore,

userMaxIp

});

await postStealFeedbackHtml(`Fail to steal anything.`);

continue;

}

const targetIpAfter = Math.max(0, targetIpBefore - actualSteal);

const actualGain = Math.min(actualSteal, Math.max(0, userMaxIp - userIpBefore));

const userIpAfter = Math.min(userMaxIp, userIpBefore + actualGain);

await targetActor.update({

"system.props.current_ip": String(targetIpAfter)

});

await userActor.update({

"system.props.current_ip": String(userIpAfter)

});

console.log(TAG, "IP TRANSFER APPLIED", {

user: userActor?.name,

userTokenName,

target: targetActor?.name,

targetName,

requestedSteal,

actualSteal,

actualGain,

targetIpBefore,

targetIpAfter,

userIpBefore,

userIpAfter,

userMaxIp

});

await postStealFeedbackHtml(

`${escapeHTML(userTokenName)} steals ${escapeHTML(actualSteal)} IP from ${escapeHTML(targetName)}!`

);

}

o = o || {}; const inMs = o.slideIn || 650, hold = o.hold || 850, outMs = o.slideOut || 650; const end = inMs + hold + outMs;

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; FOES.push(k); tokens[k] = { token: t, foot: cfg.partyFoot }; });

const CL = A.clips || {};

// cfg.live false = FULL TAKEOVER (the shot owns the board and drives S.cam: Apex Arrow's push-in); else LIVE board

const LIVE = cfg.live !== false;

const tl = oni.timeline(LIVE ? { tokens, clips: CL, images: A.images || {}, live: true, depthRef: 'k' } : { tokens, clips: CL, images: A.images || {} });

await tl.load();

const E = tl.E, seg = tl.seg, lerp = tl.lerp, TOK = tl.TOK, feet = tl.feet;

const KP = (tl.STAGE.w || 1682) / 1682;

const R = tl.rng(cfg.seed || 2525);

const rnd = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

const T = [], sfx = [];

const m = tl.mk(T);

const once = (at, fn) => { let did = false; T.push({ t0: at, t1: 1e9, fn: () => { if (!did) { did = true; try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.warn('[ONI][twins] cue threw', e); } } } }); };

const S_ = (at, url, v) => { if (url) sfx.push({ at: Math.round(at), url, v: v * (cfg.volume == null ? 0.75 : cfg.volume) }); };

const SX = (at, key, v) => S_(at, (A.sfx || {})[key], v);

const DEG = Math.PI / 180;

const K = TOK.k, KF = feet(K);

// facing: toward the first target; with none (a self-cast) the way the caster's art faces

const DIR = FOES.length ? (TOK[FOES[0]].x >= K.x ? 1 : -1) : (K.dir || 1);

const DR = (pt) => tl.depthRatio(KF, pt); // size at pt vs the caster's spot

const HB = (k) => TOK[k].h * TOK[k].foot; // body height above the feet

const tFeet = (k) => feet(TOK[k]);

const tCenter = (k) => { const f = feet(TOK[k]); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - HB(k) * 0.5 }; };

// a spot in front of a target, on the caster's side (the mockup's front(t, gap))

const front = (k, gap) => { const f = tFeet(k); return { x: f.x - DIR * gap * KP * DR(f), y: f.y }; };

// EASE names as the mockup has them

const EZ = { lin: E.lin, quad: E.ioQ, out: E.outQ, in: E.inQ, outCubic: E.outC, sine: E.sine };

const EOUTBACK = (u) => { const c1 = 1.70158, c3 = c1 + 1; return 1 + c3 * Math.pow(u - 1, 3) + c1 * Math.pow(u - 1, 2); };

// ── the caster's body: keyframed channels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

// dx / dy (scene px), lift (scene px), rot (deg, the mockup's enemy sign), sx / sy, hop (an arc on top

// of the lift), pivot (0 = feet, 1 = the mockup's 50% 55% spin pivot).

const chan = (v0) => ({ v0, segs: [] });

const valAt = (c, t) => { let v = c.v0; for (const s of c.segs) { if (t < s.t0) break; const u = s.t1 > s.t0 ? Math.min(1, (t - s.t0) / (s.t1 - s.t0)) : 1; v = s.fn ? (t >= s.t1 ? s.fn(1) : s.fn(u)) : (t >= s.t1 ? s.to : lerp(s.from, s.to, s.ease(u))); } return v; };

const key = (c, at, ms, to, ease) => { const from = valAt(c, at); c.segs.push({ t0: at, t1: at + Math.max(0, ms), from, to, ease: ease || E.lin }); c.segs.sort((a, b) => a.t0 - b.t0); };

const keyFn = (c, at, ms, fn) => { c.segs.push({ t0: at, t1: at + Math.max(1, ms), fn }); c.segs.sort((a, b) => a.t0 - b.t0); };

const BODY = { dx: chan(0), dy: chan(0), lift: chan(0), hop: chan(0), rot: chan(0), sx: chan(1), sy: chan(1), pivot: chan(0) };

let BODY_END = 0;

// pose at t: what the engine draws, plus the un-pivoted lift (anchor points use that, as the mockup does)

function pose(t) {

const dx = valAt(BODY.dx, t), dy = valAt(BODY.dy, t), lift = valAt(BODY.lift, t) + valAt(BODY.hop, t);

const rot = valAt(BODY.rot, t) * DIR * DEG, sx = valAt(BODY.sx, t), sy = valAt(BODY.sy, t);

let air = lift, ddx = dx;

if (valAt(BODY.pivot, t) >= 0.5 && rot) { const r = (dx || dy) ? tl.depthRatio(KF, { x: KF.x + dx, y: KF.y + dy }) : 1; const ph = K.h * (K.foot - 0.55) * r * sy; ddx -= ph * Math.sin(rot); air += ph * (1 - Math.cos(rot)); }

return { dx: ddx, dy, air, rot, sx, sy, lift, bx: dx };

}

// moves (mockup: moveActor / goHome / lean / squash / liftTo / spin)

const moveTo = (at, ms, pt, ease, o) => { o = o || {}; key(BODY.dx, at, ms, pt.x - KF.x, ease || EZ.sine); key(BODY.dy, at, ms, pt.y - KF.y, ease || EZ.sine); if (o.hop) { const h = o.hop * KP; keyFn(BODY.hop, at, ms, (u) => Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * h); } if (o.trail) for (const f of [0.31, 0.62, 0.93]) ghostAt(at + ms * f, o.ghost || {}); return at + ms; };

const goHome = (at, ms, o) => moveTo(at, ms, KF, EZ.quad, o);

const lean = (at, ms, deg, ease) => { key(BODY.rot, at, ms, deg, ease || EZ.out); return at + ms; };

const squash = (at, ms, sx, sy, ease) => { key(BODY.sx, at, ms, sx, ease || EZ.out); key(BODY.sy, at, ms, sy, ease || EZ.out); return at + ms; };

const liftTo = (at, ms, h, ease) => { key(BODY.lift, at, ms, h * KP, ease || EZ.outCubic); return at + ms; };

const pivot = (at, mid) => key(BODY.pivot, at, 0, mid ? 1 : 0);

// anchor points on the caster (mockup hand(a) / bodyAt(a) / feet(a)), at time t

const casterPt = (t, u, v) => { const p = pose(t), r = (p.bx || p.dy) ? tl.depthRatio(KF, { x: KF.x + p.bx, y: KF.y + p.dy }) : 1; return { x: KF.x + p.bx + DIR * K.w * u * r, y: KF.y + p.dy - p.lift - HB('k') * v * r }; };

const hand = (t) => casterPt(t, 0.3, 0.62);

const bodyAt = (t) => casterPt(t, 0, 0.5);

const cFeet = (t) => casterPt(t, 0, 0);

const headAt = (t) => casterPt(t, 0, 0.95);

// ── art copies: afterimage ghosts, scaling copies, a glow ring behind the body ──────────────

const ART = tl.art('k');

const bake = (filter, pad) => { if (!ART) return null; const w = ART.naturalWidth || ART.videoWidth || ART.width, h = ART.naturalHeight || ART.videoHeight || ART.height; if (!w || !h) return null; pad = pad || 0;

const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w + pad * 2; c.height = h + pad * 2; const x = c.getContext('2d'); try { x.filter = filter || 'none'; x.drawImage(ART, pad, pad, w, h); } catch (e) { return null; } return { cv: c, pad, w, h }; };

const GHOST = {};

const ghostImg = (o) => { const f = o.filter || (o.hue == null ? 'brightness(1.6) saturate(.4)' : 'sepia(1) saturate(5) hue-rotate(' + (o.hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(1.35)'); if (!(f in GHOST)) GHOST[f] = bake(f, 0); return GHOST[f]; };

function drawCopy(g, B, p, alpha, es) {

if (!B || alpha <= 0) return; es = es || 1;

const r = (p.dx || p.dy) ? tl.depthRatio(KF, { x: KF.x + p.dx, y: KF.y + p.dy }) : 1;

const padW = B.pad * K.w / B.w, padH = B.pad * K.h / B.h;

g.save(); g.translate(K.x + p.dx, KF.y + p.dy - p.air); if (p.rot) g.rotate(p.rot); g.scale(K.flip * p.sx * r * es, p.sy * r * es); g.globalAlpha = alpha;

g.drawImage(B.cv, -K.w / 2 - padW, -K.h * K.foot - padH, K.w + padW * 2, K.h + padH * 2); g.restore();

}

// one ghost spawned at 'at' showing the pose of that moment, fading over o.ms (mockup afterimage)

const GHOSTS = [];

function ghostAt(at, o) { o = o || {}; GHOSTS.push({ at, ms: o.ms || 380, op: o.opacity == null ? 0.5 : o.opacity, img: ghostImg(o) }); }

// ghosts every 'every' ms from 'from' to 'to' (mockup trailWhile)

function trail(from, to, every, o) { for (let t = from; t < to; t += every) ghostAt(t, o); }

m.hold(0, 1e9, (t, S) => { if (!GHOSTS.length) return; S.world.push({ z: 4, draw: (g) => { for (const q of GHOSTS) { const age = t - q.at; if (age < 0 || age > q.ms) continue; drawCopy(g, q.img, pose(q.at), q.op * (1 - age / q.ms)); } } }); });

// ── the stepped particle field (mockup addP / frame): positions scene px, velocities mockup px/ms ──

// layers: ground (under the battlers), field (over them), hit (over everything on the board)

const PL = { ground: [], field: [], hit: [] };

const LZ = { ground: 2, field: 24, hit: 46 };

const addP = (layer, p) => { PL[layer].push(Object.assign({ t: 0, life: 1000, vx: 0, vy: 0, g: 0, drag: 1 }, p)); };

const spawn = (at, fn) => once(at, fn);

let lastT = null;

m.hold(0, 1e9, (t, S) => {

const dt = lastT == null ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(50, t - lastT)); lastT = t;

for (const L in PL) { const arr = PL[L]; for (let i = arr.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const p = arr[i]; p.t += dt;

if (p.t >= p.life || p.dead) { arr.splice(i, 1); continue; }

if (p.update) p.update(p, dt); else { p.vy += p.g * dt; const f = Math.pow(p.drag, dt / 16); p.vx *= f; p.vy *= f; p.x += p.vx * dt * KP; p.y += p.vy * dt * KP; } }

if (arr.length) S.world.push({ z: LZ[L], draw: (g) => { for (const p of arr) { g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = p.comp || 'lighter'; try { p.draw(g, p, Math.min(1, p.t / p.life)); } catch (e) {} g.restore(); } } }); }

});

// mockup glow(c, x, y, r, rgb, a): a radial gradient disc

const glow = (g, x, y, r, rgb, a) => { if (!(r > 0)) return; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)'); g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 7); g.fill(); };

// floor ring (ellipse) growing r0 -> r1

function ring(at, pt, o) { o = o || {}; const rgb = o.rgb || '255,255,255', r0 = o.r0 == null ? 10 : o.r0, r1 = o.r1 == null ? 160 : o.r1, ms = o.ms || 600, sy = o.sy == null ? 0.3 : o.sy, w = o.w || 6, layer = o.layer || 'ground';

spawn(at, () => { const s = KP * DR(o.ref || pt); addP(layer, { x: pt.x, y: pt.y, life: ms, update: () => {}, draw: (g, p, t) => { const r = lerp(r0, r1, E.outC(t)) * s; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (1 - t) + ')'; g.lineWidth = w * (1 - t * 0.6) * s; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(p.x, p.y, r, r * sy, 0, 0, 7); g.stroke(); } }); }); }

// floor cracks

function crack(at, pt) { spawn(at, () => { const s = KP * DR(pt); const segs = Array.from({ length: 7 }, () => [rnd(0, 6.283), rnd(30, 80)]);

addP('ground', { x: pt.x, y: pt.y, life: 1600, comp: 'source-over', update: () => {}, draw: (g, p, t) => { g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(30,18,10,' + (t > 0.7 ? (1 - t) / 0.3 * 0.8 : 0.8) + ')'; g.lineWidth = 3 * s; for (const sg of segs) { const a = sg[0], L = sg[1]; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(p.x, p.y); g.lineTo(p.x + Math.cos(a) * L * s * 0.5, p.y + Math.sin(a) * L * s * 0.16); g.lineTo(p.x + Math.cos(a + 0.3) * L * s, p.y + Math.sin(a + 0.3) * L * s * 0.32); g.stroke(); } } }); }); }

// dust puffs kicked up from a point

function dustBurst(at, pt, o) { o = o || {}; const n = o.n || 14, rgb = o.rgb || '190,170,140'; spawn(at, () => { const s = (o.s || 1) * DR(pt);

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const an = rnd(Math.PI, Math.PI * 2); addP('field', { x: pt.x + rnd(-10, 10) * s * KP, y: pt.y, vx: Math.cos(an) * rnd(0.08, 0.25) * s, vy: Math.sin(an) * rnd(0.02, 0.1) * s, drag: 0.97, life: rnd(500, 900), r: rnd(8, 18) * s * KP, comp: 'source-over',

draw: (g, p, t) => { g.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.45 * (1 - t)) + ')'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * (1 + t), 0, 7); g.fill(); } }); } }); }

// four-point star twinkles

function twinkles(at, pt, o) { o = o || {}; const n = o.n || 10, r = (o.r == null ? 80 : o.r) * KP, rgb = o.rgb || '160,230,255', layer = o.layer || 'hit';

spawn(at, () => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) addP(layer, { x: pt.x + rnd(-r, r), y: pt.y + rnd(-r, r) * 0.8, life: rnd(500, 900), s: rnd(5, 11) * KP, update: () => {},

draw: (g, p, t) => { const k = Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * p.s; glow(g, p.x, p.y, k * 2.5, rgb, 0.7); g.fillStyle = '#fff'; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(p.x, p.y - k * 1.6); g.lineTo(p.x + k * 0.3, p.y); g.lineTo(p.x, p.y + k * 1.6); g.lineTo(p.x - k * 0.3, p.y); g.closePath(); g.fill();

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(p.x - k * 1.6, p.y); g.lineTo(p.x, p.y + k * 0.3); g.lineTo(p.x + k * 1.6, p.y); g.lineTo(p.x, p.y - k * 0.3); g.closePath(); g.fill(); } }); }); }

// sparks thrown out and falling (mockup shards)

function shards(at, pt, rgb, n, spread, layer) { spawn(at, () => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const an = rnd(0, 6.283), sp = rnd(0.15, spread);

addP(layer || 'hit', { x: pt.x, y: pt.y, vx: Math.cos(an) * sp, vy: Math.sin(an) * sp - 0.2, g: 0.0012, drag: 0.985, life: rnd(600, 1000), rot: rnd(0, 6), vr: rnd(-0.02, 0.02), s: rnd(5, 11) * KP,

draw: (g, p, t) => { p.rot += p.vr * 16; g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(p.rot); g.globalAlpha = 1 - t; g.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',1)'; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, -p.s); g.lineTo(p.s * 0.6, 0); g.lineTo(0, p.s * 0.9); g.lineTo(-p.s * 0.5, 0); g.fill(); } }); } }); }

// a rising ember (call inside a spawn)

const ember = (layer, x, y, rgb, o) => addP(layer, Object.assign({ x, y, vx: rnd(-0.03, 0.03), vy: rnd(-0.12, -0.05), life: rnd(1400, 2600), r: rnd(2, 5) }, o || {}, { draw: (g, p, t) => { const a = Math.sin(t * Math.PI); glow(g, p.x + Math.sin(p.t / 300) * 6 * KP, p.y, p.r * 3 * KP, rgb, a * 0.9); } }));

// a floating mote (call inside a spawn)

const dust = (layer, x, y, rgb, o) => addP(layer, Object.assign({ x, y, vx: rnd(-0.02, 0.02), vy: rnd(-0.02, 0.02), life: rnd(1800, 3400), r: rnd(1, 2.6) }, o || {}, { draw: (g, p, t) => { const a = Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(p.t / 120 + p.x)); g.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + a + ')'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * KP, 0, 7); g.fill(); glow(g, p.x, p.y, p.r * 4 * KP, rgb, a * 0.35); } }));

// motes homing in on a point along an arc (mockup windWisps / homing)

function wisps(at, to, o) { o = o || {}; const n = o.n || 14, rr = (o.r || 220) * KP, rgb = o.rgb || '200,255,225', ms = o.ms || 700, arc = 60 * KP;

spawn(at, () => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = rnd(0, 6.283), from = { x: to.x + Math.cos(a) * rr, y: to.y + Math.sin(a) * rr * 0.6 }; const cx = (from.x + to.x) / 2 + rnd(-arc, arc), cy = Math.min(from.y, to.y) - rnd(arc * 0.3, arc);

addP('hit', { x: from.x, y: from.y, life: ms * rnd(0.85, 1.15), r: 2, update: (p) => { const k = E.inQ(Math.min(1, p.t / p.life)), u = 1 - k; p.px = p.x; p.py = p.y; p.x = u * u * from.x + 2 * u * k * cx + k * k * to.x; p.y = u * u * from.y + 2 * u * k * cy + k * k * to.y; },

draw: (g, p) => { glow(g, p.x, p.y, p.r * 3.5 * KP, rgb, 0.95); g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',.5)'; g.lineWidth = p.r * KP; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(p.px == null ? p.x : p.px, p.py == null ? p.y : p.py); g.lineTo(p.x, p.y); g.stroke(); } }); } }); }

// comic dust puff (round blobs with a dark outline that pop, grow and fade; round 3)

function comicPuff(at, pt, o) { o = o || {}; const s = (o.s || 1), up = o.up || 0, n = o.n || 4;

spawn(at, () => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const r0 = rnd(7, 13) * s * KP;

addP('field', { x: pt.x + rnd(-14, 14) * s * KP, y: pt.y - rnd(0, 8) * s * KP, vx: rnd(-0.06, 0.06) * s, vy: -rnd(0.01, 0.05) * s - up, drag: 0.97, life: rnd(420, 650), comp: 'source-over',

g.fillStyle = '#3a2d26'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, r + 2.2 * KP, 0, 7); g.fill(); g.fillStyle = '#f2ece2'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, r, 0, 7); g.fill();

g.fillStyle = '#c9bfb2'; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x + r * 0.25, p.y + r * 0.3, r * 0.55, 0, 7); g.fill(); } }); } }); }

// a crescent slash drawn across a point (no clip), ang = the cut's angle (mockup sign, mirrored here)

function crescent(at, pt, o) { o = o || {}; const ang = (o.ang == null ? -0.5 : o.ang), len = (o.len || 160) * KP, w = (o.w || 26) * KP, rgb = o.rgb || '255,255,255', ms = o.ms || 260;

spawn(at, () => addP('hit', { x: pt.x, y: pt.y, life: ms, update: () => {}, draw: (g, p, t) => { const k = E.outC(Math.min(1, t * 1.6)); g.translate(p.x, p.y); if (DIR < 0) g.scale(-1, 1); g.rotate(ang); g.globalAlpha = 1 - Math.max(0, (t - 0.45) / 0.55);

// ── projectiles (tip at 0,0 pointing +x, mockup SHAPE units scaled by KP) ──

const SHAPE = {

arrow: (len, rgb, head) => (g) => { glow(g, -6, 0, 26, rgb, 0.55); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';

g.strokeStyle = '#6b4a2a'; g.lineWidth = 3; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(-8, 0); g.stroke();

g.fillStyle = head; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(4, 0); g.lineTo(-10, -5); g.lineTo(-10, 5); g.closePath(); g.fill();

g.fillStyle = 'rgb(' + rgb + ')'; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len + 14, 0); g.lineTo(-len, -7); g.lineTo(-len + 4, 0); g.lineTo(-len, 7); g.closePath(); g.fill(); },

};

// fly from -> to over ms (o.ease, o.arc mockup px, o.stay ms in the floor, o.trail rgb glow trail, o.z)

function fly(at, from, to, ms, draw, o) {

o = o || {}; const ease = o.ease || E.lin, arc = (o.arc || 0) * KP, sc = KP * (o.scale || 1);

const posAt = (e) => { const u = ease(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, e / ms))); return { x: lerp(from.x, to.x, u), y: lerp(from.y, to.y, u) - arc * Math.sin(Math.PI * u) }; };

const angAt = (e) => { const a = posAt(Math.max(0, e - 8)), b = posAt(Math.min(ms, e + 8)); return Math.atan2(b.y - a.y, b.x - a.x); };

const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][DEADLY-MARKSMANSHIP]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

return;

}

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

const firstTargetUuid = targetUuids[0] ?? null;

if (!firstTargetUuid) {

console.log(TAG, "No target found. Skipping.");

return;

}

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(firstTargetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) {

console.log(TAG, "Missing target actor. Skipping.");

return;

}

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

p.meta = p.meta || {};

// Read final action accuracy total AFTER all other accuracy bonuses

const accTotal = Number(p?.accuracy?.total ?? NaN);

// Read target defense from defense snapshot first, actor data as fallback

const getDef = (targetUuid, actor) => {

const row = p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget?.find(r => r?.uuid === targetUuid);

return Number(row?.defense ?? actor?.system?.props?.defense ?? 0) || 0;

};

const targetDef = getDef(firstTargetUuid, targetActor);

// Bonus damage = positive difference only

const deadlyBonus = Number.isFinite(accTotal)

? Math.max(0, accTotal - targetDef)

: 0;

const bonusBefore = Number(p?.advPayload?.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

const bonusAfter = bonusBefore + deadlyBonus;

p.meta.deadlyMarksmanshipDebug = {

target: targetActor.name,

accuracyTotal: accTotal,

targetDef,

deadlyBonus,

bonusBefore,

bonusAfter

};

context.log("Deadly Marksmanship applied", {

target: targetActor.name,

accuracyTotal: accTotal,

targetDef,

deadlyBonus,

bonusBefore,

bonusAfter

props.custom_logic_resolution:
const TAG = "[CL-RES][SNARING-ARROW][SNIPE20-SNARED]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

const args = globalThis.__ARGS ?? p?.__confirmArgs ?? {};

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

if (!targetUuids.length) {

console.warn(TAG, "No targets found.");

return;

}

const accTotal = Number(p?.accuracy?.total ?? args?.accuracyTotal ?? NaN);

const hasAccuracy =

(typeof args?.hasAccuracy === "boolean") ? args.hasAccuracy : !!p?.accuracy;

const autoHit = !!(args?.autoHit || p?.advPayload?.autoHit || p?.accuracy?.isCrit);

const SNIPE_THRESHOLD = 15;

// Canonical source template = item-owned Active Effect

const EFFECT_UUID = "Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.5K3lbMsHORKZCJWQ";

const EFFECT_ID = "5K3lbMsHORKZCJWQ";

const EFFECT_NAME = "Snared";

const getDef = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const row = p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget?.find(r => r?.uuid === targetUuid);

return Number(row?.defense ?? targetActor?.system?.props?.defense ?? 0) || 0;

};

const isHit = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const targetDef = getDef(targetUuid, targetActor);

if (!hasAccuracy) return true;

if (autoHit) return true;

if (!Number.isFinite(accTotal)) return false;

return accTotal >= targetDef;

};

// Snipe 20 gate

if (!Number.isFinite(accTotal) || accTotal < SNIPE_THRESHOLD) {

console.log(TAG, "Snipe 20 not met.", {

accTotal,

threshold: SNIPE_THRESHOLD

});

return;

}

// Resolve source effect template

let sourceEffect = await fromUuid(EFFECT_UUID);

// Fallback: resolve source item, then find by id or name

if (!sourceEffect) {

const sourceItemUuid = EFFECT_UUID.split(".ActiveEffect.")[0];

const sourceItemDoc = await fromUuid(sourceItemUuid);

sourceEffect =

Array.from(sourceItemDoc?.effects ?? []).find(e => String(e?.id ?? "") === EFFECT_ID) ??

Array.from(sourceItemDoc?.effects ?? []).find(e => {

const n1 = String(e?.name ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const n2 = String(e?.label ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const wanted = EFFECT_NAME.toLowerCase();

return n1 === wanted || n2 === wanted;

}) ??

null;

}

if (!sourceEffect) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve source effect template.", {

EFFECT_UUID,

EFFECT_ID,

EFFECT_NAME

});

return;

}

for (const targetUuid of targetUuids) {

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(targetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) continue;

const hit = isHit(targetUuid, targetActor);

if (!hit) {

console.log(TAG, "Target was not hit. Skipping.", {

target: targetActor?.name,

accTotal,

targetDef: getDef(targetUuid, targetActor)

});

continue;

}

// Duplicate check on target:

// cloned AEs can get new ids/uuids on actor, so match by name

const existingEffect =

Array.from(targetActor.effects ?? []).find(e => {

const n1 = String(e?.name ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const n2 = String(e?.label ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const wanted = EFFECT_NAME.toLowerCase();

return n1 === wanted || n2 === wanted;

}) ?? null;

if (existingEffect) {

console.log(TAG, "Effect already present. Skipping duplicate.", {

target: targetActor?.name,

existingEffect: existingEffect?.name ?? existingEffect?.label ?? "(unknown)"

});

continue;

}

const effectData = sourceEffect.toObject();

delete effectData._id;

delete effectData.id;

await targetActor.createEmbeddedDocuments("ActiveEffect", [effectData]);

console.log(TAG, "Applied Snared.", {

target: targetActor?.name,

accTotal,

sourceEffectName: sourceEffect?.name ?? sourceEffect?.label ?? "(unknown)"

});

}

const moveTo = (at, ms, pt, ease, o) => { o = o || {}; key(BODY.dx, at, ms, pt.x - KF.x, ease || EZ.sine); key(BODY.dy, at, ms, pt.y - KF.y, ease || EZ.sine); if (o.hop) { const h = o.hop * KP; keyFn(BODY.hop, at, ms, (u) => Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * h); } if (o.trail) for (const f of [0.31, 0.62, 0.93]) ghostAt(at + ms * f, o.ghost || {}); return at + ms; };

const PL = { ground: [], field: [], hit: [] };

const LZ = { ground: 2, field: 24, hit: 46 };

const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][DEADLY-MARKSMANSHIP]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

return;

}

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

const firstTargetUuid = targetUuids[0] ?? null;

if (!firstTargetUuid) {

console.log(TAG, "No target found. Skipping.");

return;

}

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(firstTargetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) {

console.log(TAG, "Missing target actor. Skipping.");

return;

}

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

p.meta = p.meta || {};

// Read final action accuracy total AFTER all other accuracy bonuses

const accTotal = Number(p?.accuracy?.total ?? NaN);

// Read target defense from defense snapshot first, actor data as fallback

const getDef = (targetUuid, actor) => {

const row = p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget?.find(r => r?.uuid === targetUuid);

return Number(row?.defense ?? actor?.system?.props?.defense ?? 0) || 0;

};

const targetDef = getDef(firstTargetUuid, targetActor);

// Bonus damage = positive difference only

const deadlyBonus = Number.isFinite(accTotal)

? Math.max(0, accTotal - targetDef)

: 0;

const bonusBefore = Number(p?.advPayload?.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

const bonusAfter = bonusBefore + deadlyBonus;

p.advPayload.bonus = bonusAfter;

p.meta.deadlyMarksmanshipDebug = {

target: targetActor.name,

accuracyTotal: accTotal,

targetDef,

deadlyBonus,

bonusBefore,

bonusAfter

};

context.log("Deadly Marksmanship applied", {

target: targetActor.name,

accuracyTotal: accTotal,

targetDef,

deadlyBonus,

bonusBefore,

bonusAfter

});
props.custom_logic_resolution:
const TAG = "[CL-RES][POISON-ARROW][SNIPE20-ENVENOMED]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

const args = globalThis.__ARGS ?? p?.__confirmArgs ?? {};

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

if (!targetUuids.length) {

console.warn(TAG, "No targets found.");

return;

}

const accTotal = Number(p?.accuracy?.total ?? args?.accuracyTotal ?? NaN);

const hasAccuracy =

(typeof args?.hasAccuracy === "boolean") ? args.hasAccuracy : !!p?.accuracy;

const autoHit = !!(args?.autoHit || p?.advPayload?.autoHit || p?.accuracy?.isCrit);

const SNIPE_THRESHOLD = 15;

// Canonical source template = item-owned Active Effect

const EFFECT_UUID = "Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.TI6txApoPwgYLHXQ";

const EFFECT_ID = "TI6txApoPwgYLHXQ";

const EFFECT_NAME = "Envenomed";

const getDef = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const row = p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget?.find(r => r?.uuid === targetUuid);

return Number(row?.defense ?? targetActor?.system?.props?.defense ?? 0) || 0;

};

const isHit = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const targetDef = getDef(targetUuid, targetActor);

if (!hasAccuracy) return true;

if (autoHit) return true;

if (!Number.isFinite(accTotal)) return false;

return accTotal >= targetDef;

};

// Snipe 20 gate

if (!Number.isFinite(accTotal) || accTotal < SNIPE_THRESHOLD) {

console.log(TAG, "Snipe 20 not met.", {

accTotal,

threshold: SNIPE_THRESHOLD

});

return;

}

// Resolve source effect template

let sourceEffect = await fromUuid(EFFECT_UUID);

// Fallback: resolve source item, then find by id or name

if (!sourceEffect) {

const sourceItemUuid = EFFECT_UUID.split(".ActiveEffect.")[0];

const sourceItemDoc = await fromUuid(sourceItemUuid);

sourceEffect =

Array.from(sourceItemDoc?.effects ?? []).find(e => String(e?.id ?? "") === EFFECT_ID) ??

Array.from(sourceItemDoc?.effects ?? []).find(e => {

const n1 = String(e?.name ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const n2 = String(e?.label ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const wanted = EFFECT_NAME.toLowerCase();

return n1 === wanted || n2 === wanted;

}) ??

null;

}

if (!sourceEffect) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve source effect template.", {

EFFECT_UUID,

EFFECT_ID,

EFFECT_NAME

});

return;

}

for (const targetUuid of targetUuids) {

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(targetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) continue;

const hit = isHit(targetUuid, targetActor);

if (!hit) {

console.log(TAG, "Target was not hit. Skipping.", {

target: targetActor?.name,

accTotal,

targetDef: getDef(targetUuid, targetActor)

});

continue;

}

// Duplicate check on target:

// do NOT trust UUID here, because cloned AEs can get new ids/uuids on actor

const existingEffect =

Array.from(targetActor.effects ?? []).find(e => {

const n1 = String(e?.name ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const n2 = String(e?.label ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

const wanted = EFFECT_NAME.toLowerCase();

return n1 === wanted || n2 === wanted;

}) ?? null;

if (existingEffect) {

console.log(TAG, "Effect already present. Skipping duplicate.", {

target: targetActor?.name,

existingEffect: existingEffect?.name ?? existingEffect?.label ?? "(unknown)"

});

continue;

}

const effectData = sourceEffect.toObject();

delete effectData._id;

delete effectData.id;

await targetActor.createEmbeddedDocuments("ActiveEffect", [effectData]);

console.log(TAG, "Applied Envenomed.", {

target: targetActor?.name,

accTotal,

sourceEffectName: sourceEffect?.name ?? sourceEffect?.label ?? "(unknown)"

});

}
